name: sharepoint-knowledge-workbench
description: Independently-installable domain plugins for the SharePoint Knowledge Workbench: source-document-extraction, document-structure-analysis, structured-content-assembly, and structured-content-rendering convert a source .docx manual into validated, structured, published content (Markdown and SharePoint ASPX); sharepoint-content-publication and sharepoint-agents-and-skills handle tenant publication and agent/native-skill lifecycle; workbench-setup provides foundational connection/config/workflow setup for the whole workbench.

plugins.name: sharepoint-content-publication
plugins.description: SharePoint tenant publication tooling: packages rendered publication output, dry-runs upload plans, reconciles tenant state, and builds safe human-reviewed SPO Site Page copy/promotion plans without raw .aspx upload or automatic tenant writes.

plugins.name: sharepoint-link-remediation
plugins.description: Generic SharePoint link extraction, rewrite-rule remediation, and post-migration link-integrity validation. Extraction and validation are read-only; remediation is dry-run by default and requires an injected writer plus a confirmation token.

plugins.name: sharepoint-discovery
plugins.description: Read-only analysis of exported classic SharePoint inventories: per-page migration complexity scoring and functional grouping of web-part code. All classification rules and behavioural knowledge are caller-supplied.

plugins.name: sharepoint-schema
plugins.description: Read-only SharePoint schema auditing: compares two exported schema snapshots for list/content-type/site-column/field variance, audits duplicate display names, and inventories Choice field option sets. Environment labels and compared properties are caller-supplied.

plugins.name: sharepoint-page-modernization
plugins.description: Analyses and converts legacy classic SharePoint pages into modern-page conversion manifests: component inventory, classification, data-driven layout selection, and component mapping with explicit gap notices. Produces plans, never tenant writes.

plugins.name: sharepoint-provisioning
plugins.description: Declarative, JSON-schema-driven SharePoint site-column, content-type, and list/library provisioning. Reconcile-not-recreate semantics, a raw Field XML workaround for calculated/lookup/user columns, and duplicate-title detection before any delete. Planning is pure; a real apply is dry-run by default and requires both an explicitly injected executor and a plan-derived confirmation token. Zero tenant I/O ships in this plugin.

plugins.name: sharepoint-migration-planning
plugins.description: Plans a SharePoint site migration end-to-end across four implemented skills: project setup (config.psd1 confirmation + working directory), site-inventory export validation (lookup-target normalization), deterministic dependency-graph analysis and deployment wave-order computation (Stage 3a, gated by completeness checks that catch a matrix silently not matching the source it claims to describe, reusing sharepoint-provisioning's wave_planning.py directly), and generated wave deployment scripts plus a human wave guide (Stage 3b, one wave at a time -- never an unattended run-everything script).

plugins.name: sharepoint-content-migration
plugins.description: Item-level SharePoint content (list-item data) migration mechanism: batched migration with retry, and the two-pass lookup-ID re-link technique (record source-to-destination IDs during a content pass, resolve lookup fields against that mapping once target lists exist). Distinct from sharepoint-provisioning (schema/list/field structure, not row data). Planning is pure; a real apply is dry-run by default and requires both an explicitly injected executor and a plan-derived confirmation token.
